reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1694 c, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ دَاوُدَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بَعْضَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ فَاعْتَرَفَ بِالزِّنَى ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to us: Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us. Another chain: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Mu'awiyah ibn Hisham narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us. Both reported from Dawud with this chain, part of the hadith. Sufyan's report says he confessed to adultery three times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1695 a, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ - عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَامِعٍ الْمُحَارِبِيُّ - عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، بْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْحَكَ ارْجِعْ فَاسْتَغْفِرِ اللَّهَ وَتُبْ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فِيمَ أُطَهِّرُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مِنَ الزِّنَى ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبِهِ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِمَجْنُونٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَرِبَ خَمْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَاسْتَنْكَهَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ مِنْهُ رِيحَ خَمْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَزَنَيْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَكَانَ النَّاسُ فِيهِ فِرْقَتَيْنِ قَائِلٌ يَقُولُ لَقَدْ هَلَكَ لَقَدْ أَحَاطَتْ بِهِ خَطِيئَتُهُ وَقَائِلٌ يَقُولُ مَا تَوْبَةٌ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ تَوْبَةِ مَاعِزٍ أَنَّهُ جَاءَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَ يَدَهُ فِي يَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ اقْتُلْنِي بِالْحِجَارَةِ - قَالَ - فَلَبِثُوا بِذَلِكَ يَوْمَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةً ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُمْ جُلُوسٌ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْتَغْفِرُوا لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالُوا غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ تَابَ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ أُمَّةٍ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ غَامِدٍ مِنَ الأَزْدِ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ طَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَيْحَكِ ارْجِعِي فَاسْتَغْفِرِي اللَّهَ وَتُوبِي إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أَرَاكَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُرَدِّدَنِي كَمَا رَدَّدْتَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ إِنَّهَا حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ آنْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ حَتَّى تَضَعِي مَا فِي بَطْنِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَفَلَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ حَتَّى وَضَعَتْ قَالَ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ قَدْ وَضَعَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذًا لاَ نَرْجُمَهَا وَنَدَعَ وَلَدَهَا صَغِيرًا لَيْسَ لَهُ مَنْ يُرْضِعُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ إِلَىَّ رَضَاعُهُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَمَهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-'Ala' al-Hamdani narrated to us: Yahya ibn Ya'la, al-Harithi al-Muharibi, narrated to us, from Ghaylan ibn Jami' al-Muharibi, from 'Alqamah ibn Marthad, from Sulayman ibn Buraydah, from his father: Ma'iz ibn Malik came to the Prophet and said, Messenger of Allah, purify me. He said, Woe to you, go back, ask Allah's forgiveness, and repent to Him. Ma'iz returned shortly afterward and repeated his request. The Prophet again told him to go back, ask forgiveness, and repent. This happened again. On the fourth time, the Messenger of Allah asked, From what should I purify you? He said, From adultery. The Prophet asked whether he was insane. He was told he was not. He asked whether he had drunk wine. A man smelled his breath and found no smell of wine. The Messenger of Allah asked, Did you commit adultery? He said yes, so the Prophet ordered him stoned. People divided: some said he was doomed and his sin had encompassed him; others said no repentance was better than Ma'iz's, who came to the Prophet, placed his hand in the Prophet's hand, and asked to be killed with stones. They remained in this discussion two or three days. Then the Messenger of Allah came while they sat, greeted them, and sat down. He said, Ask Allah to forgive Ma'iz ibn Malik. They said, May Allah forgive Ma'iz ibn Malik. The Messenger of Allah said, He has repented with a repentance that, if divided among a whole community, would suffice them. Then a woman from Ghamid of Azd came and said, Messenger of Allah, purify me. He told her to go back, ask Allah's forgiveness, and repent. She said, Do you intend to send me back as you sent Ma'iz back? He asked what was the matter. She said she was pregnant from adultery. He told her to wait until she gave birth. A man from the Ansar cared for her until she delivered, then told the Prophet. He said, Then we cannot stone her and leave her infant with no one to nurse him. A man from the Ansar offered to nurse the child. The Prophet then had her stoned.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1695 b, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي لَفْظِ الْحَدِيثِ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ الأَسْلَمِيَّ، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَزَنَيْتُ وَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ ‏.‏ فَرَدَّهُ الثَّانِيَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى قَوْمِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَعْلَمُونَ بِعَقْلِهِ بَأْسًا تُنْكِرُونَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا مَا نَعْلَمُهُ إِلاَّ وَفِيَّ الْعَقْلِ مِنْ صَالِحِينَا فِيمَا نُرَى فَأَتَاهُ الثَّالِثَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ أَيْضًا فَسَأَلَ عَنْهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّهُ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ وَلاَ بِعَقْلِهِ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الرَّابِعَةَ حَفَرَ لَهُ حُفْرَةً ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَتِ الْغَامِدِيَّةُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي قَدْ زَنَيْتُ فَطَهِّرْنِي ‏.‏ وَإِنَّهُ رَدَّهَا فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لِمَ تَرُدُّنِي لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزًا فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِمَّا لاَ فَاذْهَبِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أَتَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي خِرْقَةٍ قَالَتْ هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ حَتَّى تَفْطِمِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَطَمَتْهُ أَتَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فِي يَدِهِ كِسْرَةُ خُبْزٍ فَقَالَتْ هَذَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ قَدْ فَطَمْتُهُ وَقَدْ أَكَلَ الطَّعَامَ ‏.‏ فَدَفَعَ الصَّبِيَّ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا إِلَى صَدْرِهَا وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ فَرَجَمُوهَا فَيُقْبِلُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِحَجَرٍ فَرَمَى رَأْسَهَا فَتَنَضَّحَ الدَّمُ عَلَى وَجْهِ خَالِدٍ فَسَبَّهَا فَسَمِعَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبَّهُ إِيَّاهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَهْلاً يَا خَالِدُ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَدُفِنَتْ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn 'Abdullah ibn Numayr narrated to us; the two wordings are close. My father narrated to us: Bashir ibn al-Muhajir narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn Buraydah narrated to us, from his father: Ma'iz ibn Malik al-Aslami came to the Messenger of Allah and said, I have wronged myself and committed adultery; I want you to purify me. The Prophet turned him away. The next day he came and repeated that he had committed adultery, and the Prophet turned him away a second time. The Messenger of Allah sent for his people and asked if they knew any defect in his mind or found anything objectionable in him. They said they knew him to be sound-minded and among the best of them as far as they knew. He came a third time, and the Prophet asked them about him again; they said there was nothing wrong with him or his mind. The fourth time, the Prophet had a pit dug for him and ordered him stoned. Then the Ghamidi woman came and said she had committed adultery and wanted purification. He turned her away. The next day she asked why he sent her back and said she was pregnant. He told her to go until she gave birth. After she delivered, she brought the child wrapped in cloth. He told her to nurse him until weaning. When she had weaned him, she brought him with a piece of bread in his hand and said he had been weaned and was eating food. The Prophet entrusted the child to a Muslim man, then had a pit dug for her up to her chest and ordered the people to stone her. Khalid ibn al-Walid threw a stone that struck her head, and blood splashed on his face. He insulted her. The Prophet heard him and said, Take it easy, Khalid. By the One in whose hand is my soul, she has repented with a repentance that, if a tax collector repented with it, he would be forgiven. Then he ordered that she be prayed over, and she was buried.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1696 a, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ، مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْمُهَلَّبِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عِمْرَانَ، بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ أَتَتْ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حُبْلَى مِنَ الزِّنَى فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ حَدًّا فَأَقِمْهُ عَلَىَّ فَدَعَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلِيَّهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْسِنْ إِلَيْهَا فَإِذَا وَضَعَتْ فَائْتِنِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ وَقَدْ زَنَتْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ تَوْبَةً أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Ghassan Malik ibn 'Abd al-Wahid al-Misma'i narrated to me: Mu'adh, meaning Ibn Hisham, narrated to us: my father narrated to me, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir: Abu Qilabah narrated to me that Abu al-Muhallab told him, from 'Imran ibn Husayn: A woman from Juhaynah came to the Prophet of Allah pregnant from adultery and said, Prophet of Allah, I have incurred a prescribed punishment, so carry it out on me. The Prophet summoned her guardian and said, Treat her well; when she gives birth, bring her to me. He did so. The Prophet ordered that her clothes be secured around her, then that she be stoned. He prayed over her. 'Umar asked, Do you pray over her when she committed adultery? He said, She has repented with a repentance that, if divided among seventy people of Madinah, would suffice them. Have you found a better repentance than her giving herself for Allah Most High?

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1696 b, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us: 'Affan ibn Muslim narrated to us: Aban al-'Attar narrated to us: Yahya ibn Abi Kathir narrated to us, with this chain, with the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1697/1698 a, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، الْجُهَنِيِّ أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْشُدُكَ اللَّهَ إِلاَّ قَضَيْتَ لِي بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْخَصْمُ الآخَرُ وَهُوَ أَفْقَهُ مِنْهُ نَعَمْ فَاقْضِ بَيْنَنَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَائْذَنْ لِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّ ابْنِي كَانَ عَسِيفًا عَلَى هَذَا فَزَنَى بِامْرَأَتِهِ وَإِنِّي أُخْبِرْتُ أَنَّ عَلَى ابْنِي الرَّجْمَ فَافْتَدَيْتُ مِنْهُ بِمِائَةِ شَاةٍ وَوَلِيدَةٍ فَسَأَلْتُ أَهْلَ الْعِلْمِ فَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّمَا عَلَى ابْنِي جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ وَأَنَّ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا الرَّجْمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لأَقْضِيَنَّ بَيْنَكُمَا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ الْوَلِيدَةُ وَالْغَنَمُ رَدٌّ وَعَلَى ابْنِكَ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَتَغْرِيبُ عَامٍ وَاغْدُ يَا أُنَيْسُ إِلَى امْرَأَةِ هَذَا فَإِنِ اعْتَرَفَتْ فَارْجُمْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَدَا عَلَيْهَا فَاعْتَرَفَتْ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَتْ ‏.‏
en_text: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us: al-Layth narrated to us. Another chain: Muhammad ibn Rumh informed us: al-Layth informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Utbah ibn Mas'ud, from Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, who said: A Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah and said, I adjure you by Allah to judge between us according to Allah's Book. The other litigant, who was more learned than he, said, Yes, judge between us according to Allah's Book, and allow me to speak. The Messenger of Allah said, Speak. He said: My son worked for this man and committed adultery with his wife. I was told that my son was to be stoned, so I ransomed him for one hundred sheep and a female servant. I asked learned people, who told me my son must receive one hundred lashes and exile for a year, while this man's wife must be stoned. The Messenger of Allah said: By the One in whose hand is my soul, I will judge between you according to Allah's Book. The servant and sheep are returned. Your son receives one hundred lashes and exile for a year. Go tomorrow, Unays, to this man's wife; if she confesses, stone her. He went to her, she confessed, and the Messenger of Allah ordered that she be stoned.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1697/1698 b, book 29, باب مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir and Harmalah narrated to me: Ibn Wahb informed us: Yunus informed me. Another chain: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to me: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: my father narrated to us, from Salih. Another chain: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us, from Ma'mar. All of them reported from al-Zuhri with this chain, with the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1699 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِيَهُودِيٍّ وَيَهُودِيَّةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى جَاءَ يَهُودَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نُسَوِّدُ وُجُوهَهُمَا وَنُحَمِّلُهُمَا وَنُخَالِفُ بَيْنَ وُجُوهِهِمَا وَيُطَافُ بِهِمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَاءُوا بِهَا فَقَرَءُوهَا حَتَّى إِذَا مَرُّوا بِآيَةِ الرَّجْمِ وَضَعَ الْفَتَى الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ يَدَهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ وَقَرَأَ مَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَمَا وَرَاءَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ وَهْوَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُرْهُ فَلْيَرْفَعْ يَدَهُ فَرَفَعَهَا فَإِذَا تَحْتَهَا آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَهُمَا فَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَقِيهَا مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ بِنَفْسِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Hakam ibn Musa Abu Salih narrated to me: Shu'ayb ibn Ishaq narrated to us: 'Ubaydullah informed us, from Nafi', that 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar informed him: The Messenger of Allah was brought a Jewish man and woman who had committed adultery. He went to the Jews and asked, What do you find in the Torah for one who commits adultery? They said, We blacken their faces, make them ride facing backward, and parade them. He said, Bring the Torah if you are truthful. They brought it and recited it. When they reached the verse of stoning, the young man reading put his hand over it and read what came before and after. 'Abdullah ibn Salam, who was with the Messenger of Allah, told him to ask the man to lift his hand. He lifted it, and beneath it was the verse of stoning. The Messenger of Allah ordered them both stoned. Ibn 'Umar said: I was among those who stoned them, and I saw the man shield her from the stones with himself.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1699 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي رِجَالٌ، مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ مِنْهُمْ مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ نَافِعًا، أَخْبَرَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَمَ فِي الزِّنَى يَهُودِيَّيْنِ رَجُلاً وَامْرَأَةً زَنَيَا فَأَتَتِ الْيَهُودُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهِمَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقُوا الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us: Isma'il, meaning Ibn 'Ulayyah, narrated to us, from Ayyub. Another chain: Abu al-Tahir informed me: 'Abdullah ibn Wahb informed us: men of knowledge, including Malik ibn Anas, informed me that Nafi' informed them, from Ibn 'Umar: The Messenger of Allah stoned two Jews, a man and a woman, who had committed adultery. The Jews brought them to the Messenger of Allah, and they related the hadith in a similar manner.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1699 c, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ، جَاءُوا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ زَنَيَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Ahmad ibn Yunus narrated to us: Zuhayr narrated to us: Musa ibn 'Uqbah narrated to us, from Nafi', from Ibn 'Umar, that the Jews brought to the Messenger of Allah a man and woman from among them who had committed adultery. He related the hadith like the report of 'Ubaydullah from Nafi'.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1700 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَهُودِيٍّ مُحَمَّمًا مَجْلُودًا فَدَعَاهُمْ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ حَدَّ الزَّانِي فِي كِتَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا رَجُلاً مِنْ عُلَمَائِهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْشُدُكَ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ التَّوْرَاةَ عَلَى مُوسَى أَهَكَذَا تَجِدُونَ حَدَّ الزَّانِي فِي كِتَابِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَلَوْلاَ أَنَّكَ نَشَدْتَنِي بِهَذَا لَمْ أُخْبِرْكَ نَجِدُهُ الرَّجْمَ وَلَكِنَّهُ كَثُرَ فِي أَشْرَافِنَا فَكُنَّا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا الشَّرِيفَ تَرَكْنَاهُ وَإِذَا أَخَذْنَا الضَّعِيفَ أَقَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْحَدَّ قُلْنَا تَعَالَوْا فَلْنَجْتَمِعْ عَلَى شَىْءٍ نُقِيمُهُ عَلَى الشَّرِيفِ وَالْوَضِيعِ فَجَعَلْنَا التَّحْمِيمَ وَالْجَلْدَ مَكَانَ الرَّجْمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَوَّلُ مَنْ أَحْيَا أَمْرَكَ إِذْ أَمَاتُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏[quran sura="5" aya_start="41" aya_end="41"]{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الرَّسُولُ لاَ يَحْزُنْكَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْكُفْرِ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏[quran sura="5" aya_start="41" aya_end="41"]{‏ إِنْ أُوتِيتُمْ هَذَا فَخُذُوهُ‏}‏ يَقُولُ ائْتُوا مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنْ أَمَرَكُمْ بِالتَّحْمِيمِ وَالْجَلْدِ فَخُذُوهُ وَإِنْ أَفْتَاكُمْ بِالرَّجْمِ فَاحْذَرُوا ‏.‏ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="5" aya_start="44" aya_end="44"]{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْكَافِرُونَ‏}‏ ‏[quran sura="5" aya_start="45" aya_end="45"]{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ‏}‏ ‏[quran sura="5" aya_start="47" aya_end="47"]{‏ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَحْكُمْ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ فَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ‏}‏ فِي الْكُفَّارِ كُلُّهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us, both from Abu Mu'awiyah. Yahya said: Abu Mu'awiyah informed us, from al-A'mash, from 'Abdullah ibn Murrah, from al-Bara' ibn 'Azib: A Jew whose face had been blackened and who had been flogged passed by the Prophet. He called them and asked, Is this the prescribed punishment for adultery that you find in your Book? They said yes. He summoned one of their scholars and adjured him by Allah who revealed the Torah to Moses: Is this what you find in your Book? He said no; had you not adjured me in this way, I would not have told you. We find stoning there, but it became common among our nobles, so when we caught a noble we let him go, and when we caught a weak person we carried out the punishment. We agreed to apply one punishment to noble and low alike, so we substituted blackening the face and flogging for stoning. The Messenger of Allah said, O Allah, I am the first to revive Your command after they had let it die. He ordered the man stoned. Then Allah, Mighty and Exalted, revealed the verses in al-Ma'idah 5:41 beginning, O Messenger, do not grieve over those who hasten into disbelief, through the words, If you are given this, accept it. This means: Bring it to Muhammad; if he orders blackening and flogging, accept it, but if he gives the ruling of stoning, beware. Allah also revealed the verses 5:44, 5:45, and 5:47: Whoever does not judge by what Allah has revealed, those are the disbelievers, the wrongdoers, and the defiantly disobedient, concerning the disbelievers.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1700 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنْ نُزُولِ الآيَةِ ‏.‏
en_text: Ibn Numayr and Abu Sa'id al-Ashajj narrated to us: Waki' narrated to us: al-A'mash narrated to us with this chain, with the like of it up to the words that the Prophet ordered him stoned. He did not mention what followed about the revelation of the verse.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1701 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ رَجَمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مِنْ أَسْلَمَ وَرَجُلاً مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَامْرَأَتَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Harun ibn 'Abdullah narrated to me: Hajjaj ibn Muhammad narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj said: Abu al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah say: The Prophet stoned a man from Aslam and a Jewish man and his wife.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1701 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَامْرَأَةً ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us: Rawh ibn 'Ubadah narrated to us: Ibn Jurayj narrated to us with this chain, with the like of it, except that he said, and a woman.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1702, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى ح. وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى هَلْ رَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَعْدَ مَا أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةُ النُّورِ أَمْ قَبْلَهَا قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us: 'Abd al-Wahid narrated to us: Sulayman al-Shaybani narrated to us, who said: I asked 'Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa. Another chain: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us—the wording is his—'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq al-Shaybani, who said: I asked 'Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa whether the Messenger of Allah stoned. He said yes. I asked whether that was after Surat al-Nur was revealed or before it. He said, I do not know.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1703 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا زَنَتْ أَمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَتَبَيَّنَ زِنَاهَا فَلْيَجْلِدْهَا الْحَدَّ وَلاَ يُثَرِّبْ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَلْيَجْلِدْهَا الْحَدَّ وَلاَ يُثَرِّبْ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتِ الثَّالِثَةَ فَتَبَيَّنَ زِنَاهَا فَلْيَبِعْهَا وَلَوْ بِحَبْلٍ مِنْ شَعَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Isa ibn Hammad al-Misri narrated to us: al-Layth informed us, from Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah, who heard him say: I heard the Messenger of Allah say, If one of your slave women commits adultery and it is established, let him inflict the prescribed lashes on her without rebuking her. If she does so again, let him inflict the prescribed lashes without rebuking her. If she commits adultery a third time and it is established, let him sell her, even for a rope of hair.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1703 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، بْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ أَنَّ ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي جَلْدِ الأَمَةِ إِذَا زَنَتْ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ثُمَّ لْيَبِعْهَا فِي الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, both from Ibn 'Uyaynah. Another chain: 'Abd ibn Humayd informed us: Muhammad ibn Bakr al-Bursani informed us: Hisham ibn Hassan informed us. Both reported from Ayyub ibn Musa. Another chain: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Abu Usamah and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Umar. Another chain: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me: Ibn Wahb narrated to us: Usamah ibn Zayd narrated to me. Another chain: Hannad ibn al-Sari, Abu Kurayb, and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us, from 'Abdah ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq. All of them reported from Sa'id al-Maqburi, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet. Ibn Ishaq's report from Sa'id, from his father, from Abu Hurayrah says regarding the flogging of a slave woman who commits adultery three times: Then sell her the fourth time.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1703 c, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الأَمَةِ إِذَا زَنَتْ وَلَمْ تُحْصِنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ إِنْ زَنَتْ فَاجْلِدُوهَا ثُمَّ بِيعُوهَا وَلَوْ بِضَفِيرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ لاَ أَدْرِي أَبَعْدَ الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَالضَّفِيرُ الْحَبْلُ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abdullah ibn Maslamah al-Qa'nabi narrated to us: Malik narrated to us. Another chain: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us—the wording is his—saying: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Messenger of Allah was asked about a slave woman who commits adultery and has not been married. He said: If she commits adultery, flog her; if she does so again, flog her; if she does so again, flog her; then sell her, even for a plaited rope. Ibn Shihab said: I do not know whether that is after the third or fourth time. In al-Qa'nabi's report Ibn Shihab explained that a plaited rope means a cord.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1704 a, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الأَمَةِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ وَالضَّفِيرُ الْحَبْلُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu al-Tahir narrated to us: Ibn Wahb informed us: I heard Malik say: Ibn Shihab narrated to me, from 'Ubaydullah ibn 'Abdullah ibn 'Utbah, from Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, that the Messenger of Allah was asked about a slave woman. They related a report like theirs, but did not mention Ibn Shihab's explanation that the plaited rope is a cord.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1704 b, book 29, باب رَجْمِ الْيَهُودِ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ فِي الزِّنَا ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، وَزَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَالشَّكُّ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا جَمِيعًا فِي بَيْعِهَا فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Amr al-Naqid narrated to me: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: my father narrated to me, from Salih. Another chain: 'Abd ibn Humayd informed us: 'Abd al-Razzaq informed us: Ma'mar informed us. Both reported from al-Zuhri, from 'Ubaydullah, from Abu Hurayrah and Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani, from the Prophet, with the like of Malik's hadith. Both chains are uncertain whether she is sold after the third or fourth time.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1705 a, book 29, باب تَأْخِيرِ الْحَدِّ عَنِ النُّفَسَاءِ، ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ خَطَبَ عَلِيٌّ فَقَالَ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ أَقِيمُوا عَلَى أَرِقَّائِكُمُ الْحَدَّ مَنْ أَحْصَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْصِنْ فَإِنَّ أَمَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَنَتْ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَجْلِدَهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ حَدِيثُ عَهْدٍ بِنِفَاسٍ فَخَشِيتُ إِنْ أَنَا جَلَدْتُهَا أَنْ أَقْتُلَهَا فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْسَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami narrated to us: Sulayman Abu Dawud narrated to us: Za'idah narrated to us, from al-Suddi, from Sa'd ibn 'Ubaydah, from Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, who said: 'Ali addressed the people: O people, carry out the prescribed punishment on your enslaved men and women, whether or not they have been married. A slave woman belonging to the Messenger of Allah committed adultery, and he ordered me to flog her. She had only recently given birth, and I feared that if I flogged her I would kill her. I told the Prophet about this, and he said, You did well.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1705 b, book 29, باب تَأْخِيرِ الْحَدِّ عَنِ النُّفَسَاءِ، ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَنْ أَحْصَنَ مِنْهُمْ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْصِنْ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ اتْرُكْهَا حَتَّى تَمَاثَلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated it to us: Yahya ibn Adam informed us: Isra'il narrated to us, from al-Suddi, with this chain. He did not mention whether they had been married or not. He added in the report: Leave her until she recovers.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1706 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِرَجُلٍ قَدْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فَجَلَدَهُ بِجَرِيدَتَيْنِ نَحْوَ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفَعَلَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ اسْتَشَارَ النَّاسَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ أَخَفَّ الْحُدُودِ ثَمَانِينَ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ عُمَرُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us: I heard Qatadah report from Anas ibn Malik that a man who had drunk wine was brought to the Prophet, who flogged him with two palm branches about forty times. Abu Bakr did the same. When it was 'Umar's time, he consulted the people. 'Abd al-Rahman said, The lightest prescribed punishment is eighty. 'Umar ordered that amount.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1706 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجُلٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Habib al-Harithi narrated to us: Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us: I heard Anas say that a man was brought to the Messenger of Allah. He related something like it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1706 c, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَلَدَ فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالْجَرِيدِ وَالنِّعَالِ ثُمَّ جَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ عُمَرُ وَدَنَا النَّاسُ مِنَ الرِّيفِ وَالْقُرَى قَالَ مَا تَرَوْنَ فِي جَلْدِ الْخَمْرِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ أَرَى أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا كَأَخَفِّ الْحُدُودِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَلَدَ عُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Mu'adh ibn Hisham narrated to us: my father narrated to me, from Qatadah, from Anas ibn Malik, that Allah's Prophet flogged for drinking wine with palm branches and sandals. Abu Bakr then flogged forty times. When 'Umar came to power and people had moved into the countryside and villages, he asked what they thought about flogging for wine. 'Abd al-Rahman ibn 'Awf said, I think you should make it like the lightest prescribed punishment. 'Umar then flogged eighty times.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1706 d, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ.
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us with this chain, with the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1706 e, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّوسلم كَانَ يَضْرِبُ فِي الْخَمْرِ بِالنِّعَالِ وَالْجَرِيدِ أَرْبَعِينَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الرِّيفَ وَالْقُرَى ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Waki' narrated to us, from Hisham, from Qatadah, from Anas, that the Prophet used to flog for wine with sandals and palm branches forty times. He then mentioned a report like theirs, but did not mention the countryside and villages.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1707 a, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الدَّانَاجِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ فَيْرُوزَ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ عَامِرٍ الدَّانَاجِ حَدَّثَنَا حُضَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ أَبُو سَاسَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ وَأُتِيَ بِالْوَلِيدِ قَدْ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَزِيدُكُمْ فَشَهِدَ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلاَنِ أَحَدُهُمَا حُمْرَانُ أَنَّهُ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ وَشَهِدَ آخَرُ أَنَّهُ رَآهُ يَتَقَيَّأُ فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَتَقَيَّأْ حَتَّى شَرِبَهَا فَقَالَ يَا عَلِيُّ قُمْ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ قُمْ يَا حَسَنُ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ وَلِّ حَارَّهَا مَنْ تَوَلَّى قَارَّهَا - فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَ عَلَيْهِ - فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ قُمْ فَاجْلِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَجَلَدَهُ وَعَلِيٌّ يَعُدُّ حَتَّى بَلَغَ أَرْبَعِينَ فَقَالَ أَمْسِكْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ جَلَدَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعِينَ وَجَلَدَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَرْبَعِينَ وَعُمَرُ ثَمَانِينَ وَكُلٌّ سُنَّةٌ وَهَذَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ زَادَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ حَدِيثَ الدَّانَاجِ مِنْهُ فَلَمْ أَحْفَظْهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and 'Ali ibn Hujr narrated to us; they said: Isma'il, Ibn 'Ulayyah, narrated to us, from Ibn Abi 'Arubah, from 'Abdullah al-Danaj. Another chain: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim al-Hanzali—the wording is his—informed us: Yahya ibn Hammad narrated to us: 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn al-Mukhtar narrated to us: 'Abdullah ibn Fayruz, the freedman of Ibn 'Amir al-Danaj, narrated to us: Hudayn ibn al-Mundhir Abu Sasan narrated to us. He said: I was present with 'Uthman ibn 'Affan when al-Walid was brought after he had prayed the dawn prayer as two units, then asked, Shall I add more for you? Two men testified against him: one, Humran, testified that he drank wine, and another said he saw him vomit. 'Uthman said, He would not have vomited unless he had drunk it. He said, 'Ali, stand and flog him. 'Ali said, Hasan, stand and flog him. Hasan said, Let the one who took its sweetness bear its bitterness. He seemed displeased with him, so 'Uthman said, 'Abdullah ibn Ja'far, stand and flog him. He flogged him while 'Ali counted, until he reached forty; then 'Ali said, Stop. He said: The Prophet flogged forty, Abu Bakr flogged forty, and 'Umar flogged eighty. Each is a Sunnah, and this is dearer to me. 'Ali ibn Hujr adds that Isma'il said: I heard the report of al-Danaj from him, but did not retain it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1707 b, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ عُمَيْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أُقِيمُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ حَدًّا فَيَمُوتَ فِيهِ فَأَجِدَ مِنْهُ فِي نَفْسِي إِلاَّ صَاحِبَ الْخَمْرِ لأَنَّهُ إِنْ مَاتَ وَدَيْتُهُ لأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَسُنَّهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Minhal al-Darir narrated to me: Yazid ibn Zuray' narrated to us: Sufyan al-Thawri narrated to us, from Abu Hasin, from 'Umayr ibn Sa'id, from 'Ali, who said: Whenever I carried out a prescribed punishment on someone and he died from it, I felt no misgiving except in the case of the wine drinker. If he died, I would pay compensation for him, because the Messenger of Allah did not establish a fixed rule for it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1707 c, book 29, باب حَدِّ الْخَمْرِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us with this chain, with the like of it.
